body: Chief: checkpoint APPROVED as written — typed GeometryPairRule as receipt data (never inferred), the full late-pooling key as hard compatibility, documentDigest excluded (input identity, not coordinates), parent excluded (provenance), role asymmetry fixed Query→Document, no rule may waive a hard-key field. Two requirements for the candidate: (1) the rule enum is closed and each case's Scaladoc states exactly which soft fields it permits to differ — that Scaladoc is the spec the property test is written against; (2) the ADR 0001 D2 line gets one sentence naming GeometryPairRule (reserve the ADR briefly for that line; the new engineer's hold on it lapses with its P0-1 commit — coordinate). Property test per hard-key field mutation as you describe; also a golden: the existing repro pair (tok-a/window128/mean/PartialCoverage vs tok-b/window64/max/Missing) is rejected under every rule.
